title: THE HELEN TOWER · HYBRID FLOORS
why: GREEN (8 h, nothing sore, wants it hard) after a ground/mobility day that spared the legs. Tower shape is back (last 09-19): 5 descending floors for time, run leg GROWS as the reps shrink, built from the CrossFit run-plus-descending-reps WOD family (Helen, 400 m run + swings + pull-ups) on your bells.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day B · ankles / knees / hips

blocks.title: THE HELEN TOWER · 5 FLOORS · FOR TIME
blocks.meta: 5 FLOORS · one clock · cap 28:00 · reps FALL each floor, the run leg GROWS · 2×45 lb + 52 lb DB
blocks.format: Floor 1 → 5 straight through, no rest intervals. Score = floors finished inside 28:00 (green 5 / yellow 4). Stretch = all 5 under 24:00.
blocks.workRest: LEG closes every floor, flat @ 8.5 mph: 0.15 · 0.20 · 0.25 · 0.30 · 0.35 mi (1.25 mi).

items.name: S1 · Double deadlift 2×45 lb · 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4
items.detail: bells outside the feet, stand tall, tap and go

items.name: S2 · Double jerk 2×45 lb · 10 / 8 / 6 / 4 / 2
items.detail: rack once, quick knee bend, drive, punch under, lock out

items.name: S3 · Gorilla row 52 lb · 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4 (alternating)
items.detail: flat back, bell between the feet

items.name: S4 · Front-rack split squat 2×45 lb · 10 / 8 / 6 / 4 / 2 per side
items.detail: WILDCARD (13 d) · rear knee kisses the floor

items.name: S5 · V-up · 20 / 16 / 12 / 8 / 4
items.detail: toes-to-bar stand-in, hands to feet at the top

items.name: LEG · 0.15 → 0.35 mi @ 8.5 flat
items.detail: straight off the V-ups onto the belt

blocks.noteGreen: Green = 5 floors inside 28:00. Stretch = under 24:00. Log total time, slowest station, RPE.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 4 floors (stop after the 0.30 mi leg), split squat 8 / 6 / 4 / 2.
blocks.text: Double jerk: both bells racked, a fast knee bend and drive, then drop under the bells and stand them out; rack once per floor. Gorilla row: hip-width stance, one 52 lb bell on the floor between the feet, row one hand then the other, torso still. Front-rack split squat: both bells racked, long stride, rear knee to the floor, all reps one side then switch. V-up: legs straight, reach hands to feet, back flat on the way down.

blocks.title: THE HELEN FINISH · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · lateral + anti-extension close · straight through

items.name: Side bend 35 lb ×10/side
items.detail: bell at the side, slide down the leg, pull back up with the far-side obliques

items.name: Dragon flag negative ×6, 3-ct
items.detail: hands on the bench behind the head, lower the body as one line
